description: Make a link to one of this workspace's saved stills templates (from stills_templates_list, source workspace). Whoever opens it can copy the template with stills_template_import. Only the layout travels: where the photo slots are, their layers, the frame and the slide count. Photos, words, stickers and frame pictures do not, and a template that has a frame picture is refused. The link works for 30 days.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_template_share
title: Share a stills template
